name: Diagnostic.X

dialogue: Hello — I am a demo guide, not a doctor. I can show you around the kiosk.
If you feel unwell, please see a real clinician. I will point you to one.
The vitals data is at the Medical Kiosk. Collect it there, then stand in the kiosk and I will walk you through what it can — and cannot — do.
I am a demo guide, not a doctor. If you feel unwell, see a real clinician. I will point you to one.
The Imaging AI in the 4D Imaging Room sees what I cannot. When the kiosk is done with you, go and ask it for the tour.
npcs.name: Medical AI Avatar

dialogue: The imaging room turns scans into something you can walk around.
Every image here is a teaching example — never a diagnosis.
The scan spark is in the 4D Imaging Room. Collect it, stand in the room, and I will show you how the imaging works.
Four dimensions, one room, and a lot of patience. The picture is only useful if someone can explain it.
The Scientist Assistant in the Virtual Molecular Lab takes the pictures I make and asks what they mean. Go and see.
npcs.name: Imaging AI

dialogue: The molecular lab lets you hold a molecule in your hands — carefully.
Ask me about any sample and I will show you its story.
The sample relic is in the Virtual Molecular Lab. Collect it, stand in the lab, and we will look at it together.
The Office AI keeps the Metaverse Medical Office running while I stay in the lab. We compare notes at the Steward Council.
A sample is a question in a bottle. The lab does not answer it — it teaches you to ask it better.
npcs.name: Scientist Assistant Avatar

dialogue: Welcome to the office. I keep the schedule and the forms in order.
Your visit notes stay yours — the office never shares them.
The office data is in the Metaverse Medical Office. Collect it there, then come back and tell me what the office should do next.
The Medical AI Avatar runs the kiosk, I run the office, and the Steward Council runs the decisions. That order matters.
If the kiosk sent you, you have already checked in. The office is where the check-in becomes a plan.
npcs.name: Office AI Avatar

dialogue: Welcome. I keep the doors open and the stewards informed.
If you need a human decision, the Steward Council is where it lands.
The host spark is by the Alignment Evaluation Gate. Collect it there, stand at the gate, and you will see what I see every day.
The Steward Liaison carries messages to the Steward Council. I keep the doors open; the liaison keeps the words moving.
This world is a demo, not a clinic. The Medical Kiosk shows what a kiosk could do — a real clinician does the rest.
npcs.name: Host Advisor

dialogue: I carry messages between this world and the Steward Council — I never decide for them.
The steward seats are held by humans. My job is to make sure their words arrive intact.
The liaison data is at the Steward Council. Collect it there — the council floor is where messages become decisions.
Three steward seats, all held by humans. I carry the words; I never cast the vote.
The Alignment Advisor checks plans at the gate before they reach the council. Bring me the flagged ones first.
npcs.name: Steward Liaison

dialogue: I check plans against the alignment gate before they go anywhere.
If a plan cannot pass the gate in public, it does not pass at all.
The alignment spark is by the Alignment Evaluation Gate. Collect it, stand at the gate, and check the plan against it.
The gate is not a wall, it is a mirror. A plan that cannot pass in public does not pass at all.
The Host Advisor opens the doors, the Steward Liaison carries the words, and I hold the mirror. Between the three of us, nothing slips through unseen.
npcs.name: Alignment Advisor

sources: Anchor: lat 5.342706937662501, lon 101.5663444901012. Status anchored = real-world anchor coordinate exists; rp1 null, NOT live on RP1.
Fabric: 30 nodes total (scene root + 18 top-level + nested Agent/Swarm children); 12 distinct GLB refs, all unhosted — see missing_models.

Districts/buildings = the real 'Zone · ...' nodes. NPCs = the real 'Agent · ...' nodes (nested under their zones; NPC position = zone position + the agent node's local offset) plus all three real 'Advisor · ...' nodes (Host Advisor, Steward Liaison, Alignment Advisor; top-level fabric positions through the world transform). The 'Steward seat 1–3 · human' nodes are human seats, not game characters, and are not NPCs. All NPC dialogue is original game dialogue, never attributed to a real person.
Biome 'campus' is a design choice for this interpretation.
Agent companions are game characters representing the real Virtuals agents (agents.json); their live instances are offline — not live connections.
Zones (5): Medical Kiosk, 4D Imaging Room, Virtual Molecular Lab, Metaverse Medical Office, Steward Council.
Screening-support framing only: nothing in this world diagnoses, and no NPC claims to be a clinician.
